slides.text:
Apple Health is
a filing cabinet

It keeps everything

And decides nothing

Which is fine —
that is its job

Filing is not analysis

The cabinet stays

Something else reads it

And says something
you can act on

slides.heading: You had the data. You needed a reader.
slides.body: SOMA sits on top of Apple Health and turns the archive into a plan for today
